decision: Do not retain exact ModelOpt compact cache as one undifferentiated unfinished foundation feature. Three separate questions have different outcomes: raw compact storage/API exists; selecting its dtype/scale/backend is engine policy; exact exporter/runtime equivalence is artifact qualification.

The weight artifact and static FP8 kv_cache_scheme do not prescribe one compact cache byte ABI. An engine can explicitly select existing plain BF16 compact storage or a declared uniform E4 cache policy without changing weight precision identity. It must not infer that policy from NVFP4/FP8 labels or silently use unrelated checkpoint scalars.

For an engine-selected uniform E4 raw CKV512(+KPE64) policy, existing MlaBatchCapacity+CacheStorage.float8(shared_scale), CacheEncode and PagedAppend(role=kMla)/MLA reader express the storage/update/read boundary. No new registry, owner, default cache inference or arithmetic operator is justified by catalog28/29 alone.

Scaled DSA656/528 is a genuinely distinct optional codec/producer-reader adaptation not represented by uniform CacheStorage or the Hyle584B RowCache. It is not required by the pinned catalog29 TRTLLM command; catalog28 does not choose it. Only an explicitly selected scaled-DSA policy would turn it into this engine adapter requirement.

profile28.fact: README uses lmsysorg/sglang:latest and modelopt_fp4, with no KV dtype or DSA backend selection. There is no unique publisher raw-E4 or scaled-DSA default to implement from this command.

profile29.fact: README explicitly chooses SGLang fp8_e4m3 and both trtllm DSA backends; vLLM example says fp8 but its image/backend choices still affect the layout. These are serving policy declarations, not static tensor packing metadata.

fixed_runtime_mechanism.raw: SGLang calculate_mla_kv_cache_dim returns kv_lora_rank+qk_rope_head_dim for actual TRTLLM selection. The raw writer casts the latent and any nonempty RoPE tail to E4, without embedded token scales. GLM Pro is512+64=576B; Flash NoPE is512B. Hyle shares the same CKV bank as V prefix.
fixed_runtime_mechanism.scaled: Other DSA paths add four F32 group128 scales to512 E4 CKV and keep optional64 RoPE values BF16:656B or528B NoPE. vLLM canonicalization explicitly rewrites the generic fp8 request to fp8_ds_mla for selected backends, proving the generic dtype label is insufficient.
fixed_runtime_mechanism.age: These are exact cached source snapshots read now, not a claim about latest upstream or the publisher unpinned Docker image.

source_determination.producer_math: Pinned ModelOpt4956213 hook quantizes already-expanded key_states/value_states at the HF attention interface. The HF reference expands latent with kv_b_proj/expand_kv before cache update. Linear expansion followed by QDQ does not generally commute with quantizing the latent, so expanded K/V calibration may not be attached to raw CKV.

current_library_boundary.supported_explicit: MlaBatchCapacity independently chooses Q/Y type,512 or576 compact geometry and one CacheStorage. That shared interpretation governs K/QK and V/PV; ordinary independent K/V scalar pairs are deliberately not accepted as the same compact bank.
current_library_boundary.writer_connection_source: Current PagedAppend explicitly accepts kMla only with an MLA schema and uses its canonical single-row carrier. CacheEncode accepts the same explicit E4 CacheStorage. Source permits one encoded latent row -> original append transaction -> original typed MLA reader without a second cache owner; this report does not claim the entire composed native journey was executed.
current_library_boundary.existing_numerical_evidence: Original compact_mla_e4_fixture reader cases use caller-supplied shared scales,512/576 geometry, two slots/epochs and old result/page authority. Earlier four-backend qualification is cited by compact-mla-e4-reference-2026-10-21.json, not rerun here.
current_library_boundary.unrepresented_optional_format: CacheStorage currently describes plain F16/BF16/F32/E4 fixed scalar or Q8_0. RowCacheEncoding.float8_block64_tail64 is584B and explicitly Hyle-specific; neither is a reinterpretation of group128/F32-scale DSA656/528.

missing_facts_not_missing_primitives: Exact ModelOpt29 a4bc45b30 exporter source is absent from retained producer record; current turn did not query for it. Profile28 producer version0.0.0 is insufficient to identify an exporter.
Sampled header scale-key absence does not prove every original shard has no scalar. No authenticated compact scalar operand or complete publisher container/backend revision has been established.

Even with shared scale1 explicitly chosen by an engine, Hyle SATFINITE/nonfinite-publication contract and each native cast/query-quantization/accumulation tree are not automatically byte/quality equivalent to publisher serving. Nonunit expanded K/V scales especially cannot be guessed into compact storage.
Full-artifact cache-policy binding, numeric quality and throughput are unverified. These are distinct from existence of the bottom-level storage/update/read capability.

actionable_closure.now: Classify catalog28/29 cache subitem as existing explicit library API + engine-selected policy, exact-artifact equivalence unqualified. Do not leave it phrased as unknown missing primitive and do not add speculative adapter code.
actionable_closure.if_finite_consumer_is_needed: A future GLM consumer must declare geometry(raw512 NoPE or576 Rope), cache storage/scale provenance and Q/Y policy before Graph cold assembly, then use the existing one-bank schema/append/reader. Explicit BF16 or engine-defined unit E4 is a policy choice, not a recovered ModelOpt scalar.
actionable_closure.if_exact_raw_equivalence_is_required: Authenticate the chosen serving implementation and scale meaning/operands first, preserve independent old readers and existing lease/retirement/budget. A bounded sameGraph encode->kMla append->reader journey can then qualify composition with existing APIs; no new owner is needed.
actionable_closure.if_scaled_DSA_is_explicitly_required: Add and qualify its named group128-scale/BF16-tail encoding and reader together; preserve actual byte ABI and source math. This is a separate optional representation task, not a silently selected fallback for28/29.

limits: Read-only bounded source resolution. No new numeric/native qualification, latest-upstream claim, artifact payload/scalar claim, server/loader prerequisite or performance result.
